answer: A newcomer key may bid only after three established keys each sign a whisper for it, and every whisper locks ripple that burns if the newcomer is later slashed. A sponsor's n-th live whisper locks 50·n² ripple, and its total locked ripple may never exceed the nadir of its balance over the last 30 epochs, so borrowed capital cannot sponsor. Three strangers admit an honest newcomer for 150 ripple. An operator backing 100 clones from 10 of its own sponsors locks 472,750 ripple per sponsor, 4.7 million held for 30 epochs, or must pay 300 unrelated sponsors to risk theirs.
